reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The system uses an orthogonal chirp division multiplexing (OCDM) waveform-based terahertz-over-fiber (ToF) system for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) applications. The OCDM waveform is generated using a discrete Fresnel transform and is used for both communication and sensing. The system uses a photonic-based approach, with an optical frequency comb generated using a phase modulator and an external cavity laser. The OCDM signal is modulated onto the optical frequency comb and transmitted over a 10 km optical fiber and a 3.14 m wireless link. The received signal is then processed using a Schottky mixer and a digital signal processing algorithm to extract the communication and sensing information.
